canonical.deadline: deadline: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ, real Gregorian UTC; no deadlineUnixMs/version/status aliases
canonical.nulls: only explicitly nullable fields permit null; no omitted required nullable field
canonical.unknownKeys: all protocol/control objects additionalProperties=false; registered payload slots require second validation
canonical.ids: ASCII bounded128, operation IDs96; no URLs/paths/code; IDs are not authorization
canonical.revisions: canonical decimal uint64 strings, runtime bound check; epoch separate from revisions

framing.wire: 4-byte unsigned big-endian UTF8 byte length then exactly one JSON object
framing.effectiveCap: registry-owned per kind/operation/direction; channel pre-admission max before allocation, operation exact cap before effects; never caller budget/cap
guards: reject duplicate keys at every depth
strict UTF8, no BOM/unpaired surrogate/nonfinite number/trailing data

finite depth64 and nodes1000000; protocol/control JSON integers <=53-bit; uint64 revisions decimal strings; provider large numbers/raw bodies need registry-qualified lossless representation, never coercion/truncation
reject wrong protocol/unknown fields and unauthenticated reflection
no dynamic network schema refs; load only manifest and registered immutable schema digests
framing.lengthNote: schema string maxLength is not UTF8 byte cap; runtime validates encoded/raw slot lengths and frame bytes

authentication.source: existing trusted authenticated same-user channel, not a self-asserted caller field
authentication.binding: inherited authority maps channel to binding/purpose/operation allowlist; registry immutable owner input
authentication.dedup: requestId binds authenticated caller, binding, operation/version, target,args and authorization; mismatched reuse rejects
authentication.publicNever: cookies/CSRF/risk/private context/credential hashes/paths/raw auth errors; genuine confirmation verified by existing action owner

requests.perform: registry supplies schemas/transport/semantics/caps/plans; confirmationRef required but null for non-confirmed reads
requests.recoverNew: no implicit enrollment; classified rejectedRequestId required except authorized_replacement; authorization ref checked and cause derived/verified by owner; durable dedup same rejected epoch/cause
requests.recoverResume: same claimId/binding/epoch, fresh authorized operation deadline; retain counts/fences/candidate; no caller phase/candidate selector
requests.cancel: cancel schema only; requestId is control correlation, targetRequestId is original. Accept ONLY same authenticated caller AND same live authenticated channel + binding. Payload cannot name another caller/channel. Wrong caller/channel behaves not_found. Cannot extend deadline/retry/replay or terminate shared browser. ACK is not completion; terminal result remains correlated to original request.

responseRules: kind ties to admitted request; performed echoes operation ID/version
failure.certainty/nextAction/retryNotBefore must equal top-level values; retryable cannot override registry/fences
performed/recovered completed means known effect outcome, not universal exactly-once
recovered requires ACCEPTED; paused/rejected/uncertain recovery uses failed + claim projection
unenrolled inspection has null generation/revision/identity; ready requires non-null validated binding
protocol_error reflects IDs only after syntax/authorization validation, otherwise null; oversized/invalid transport may close without response
cancel withdrawn=>not_dispatched, requested=>uncertain, not_found=>null; no false stopped/completed claim
Failure.detailCode must be null or in owner registry detailCodes; never echo exception/input/token. Performed/recovered receipt and phase/counter correlations require runtime validation.

privateABI.transport: FD3 duplex inside trusted authority; public stdio distinct; fixed pinned adapter entry only
privateABI.lease: all fields echoed exactly and checked against held guard/registry/channel, one invocation only; not trusted merely because present
privateABI.sequence: per direction canonical uint64, starts0, contiguous; replay/out-of-order rejects; invoke authority seq0
privateABI.checkpoint: Before-effect checkpoint requires durable checkpoint_ack authorizedToProceed=true before effect; no ACK means no proceed. Business execute uses EXECUTE_READY/EXECUTING/EXECUTE_RESULT with claimId=null; reconciliation uses RECONCILING. Recovery uses ClaimPhase and non-null claimId. Registry validates evidence; parent loss preserves claim/dispatch fences.
privateABI.revision: lease baseCredentialRevision/epoch pin context; checkpoints may advance stateRevision. Owner commits delta against current stateRevision under same guard after verifying unchanged credential base, not a stale checkpoint revision.
privateABI.candidate: inline or private opaque staging ref, one-use lease/claim bound, byte/custody/digest checks; never public response. No caller filename or recursive lock.
privateABI.result: registry selects private result/context/delta/proof schemas; separate public result validation/redaction mandatory. Failed/uncertain state delta adoption requires provider-qualified rule; never trust arbitrary failed candidate.
privateABI.cancel: same lease/parent lifetime; parent closure/deadline stops pending effects, preserves uncertainty; child cannot kill shared browser or independently resume
privateABI.parentLifetime: owner-issued inherited channel token, not PID; disconnect fences lease, no new provider effect; persist/check ambiguity before any later resume

registryRules.keys: Unique operationId/version/requestKind, schemaId, adapterId, planId. Registry file digest is pinned externally; ownerArtifactSha256 binds the containing installed owner artifact, not a self-hash. Immutable owner input, never caller supplied.
registryRules.builtinOperations: Inspect/RecoverNew/RecoverResume/Cancel map to owner fixed registry entries, not caller-selected operation IDs
registryRules.slots: provider target,args,result,context,candidate,delta,proof,evidence schemas mandatory for used slots; closed properties recursively where objects are not intentional typed maps; no arbitrary URL/code/path selector
registryRules.modes: inspect/control core_local with no adapter; perform fixed transport; mutation confirmation/action owner and no auto-retry; safe-read retry<=1 only qualified
registryRules.budgets: owner selects plan; sum remaining required queue/import/startup/capture/proof/action/commit/cleanup/ipc reserves fits remaining absolute deadline before effects; RPC nested; insufficient=>budget_insufficient. No global timeout, no native budget increase/reset. Warm-only cannot turn into cold. Fresh Recover does not revive expired Perform.
registryRules.caps: per-operation explicit limits <=hard safety ceiling; preserve native limits and parser slots. Setting large cap does not grant more requests/provider scope. No client-selected plan/cap.
registryRules.schemas: schema IDs are registry keys resolved from reviewed immutable local artifact; no caller-selected or remote fetch

G1_recovery_only.scope: only fixed readiness/recovery kinds, not all business operations

Reddit_cursor_parity.requirement: exact maximum survives UTF8/JSON escaping+envelope; max+1 rejects by native cursor rule, no truncation

native_body_parity.requirement: body maximum preserved; total escaping/envelope must fit registry cap, or choose reviewed nontruncating representation; max+1 native body rejected

StorageBackend.types: registry-policy $defs StorageBackend/BackendExpected/BackendCommitResult; v2 A_backend snapshot/guard/SQLite/paired-state contract unchanged
StorageBackend.counters: authority epoch versus stateRevision/credentialRevision; claimVersion internal CAS; routine SetCookie preserves epoch
StorageBackend.phaseClarification: ACQUIRING/PROVED/COMMITTING make v2 before-acquisition/proof/publication checkpoints explicit, no extra auth attempt
StorageBackend.resume: only evidence-bound v2 transitions; counts monotonic, max2 readiness resumes proposed/stricter native wins; no PID/TTL reset
